evidence:
refs.bib has power2022grokking and gromov2023grokking, but no section cites them. Grepping sections/*.tex finds only morwani, nanda, chughtai, mccracken, wei, alon, hoeffding. Liu 2022 and Zhong 2023 are not in the bib.

Sources fetched this session:
(1) arXiv 2201.02177, Power et al. From the PDF: "We train on the binary operation of division mod 97", and the appendix lists the "binary operations that we have tried (for a prime number p = 97)". This paper is the origin of the grokking testbed.
(2) arXiv 2301.02679, Gromov 2023. Sec. 3.1, Eqs. (6)-(7) give an analytic solution for modular addition by a two-layer net with quadratic activation. The weights are periodic with frequencies k = 0..(p-1)/2, the phases are random and satisfy constraint (12), and each frequency repeats with different random phases. This is the precursor of the Fourier constructions, so it also belongs in prelim/approach.
(3) arXiv 2205.10343, Liu et al. The arXiv page lists NeurIPS 2022. Effective theory and phase diagram of grokking.
(4) arXiv 2306.17844, Zhong et al. The arXiv page lists NeurIPS 2023. On modular addition, different hyperparameters and inits give Clock vs Pizza algorithms.

Venues for (3) and (4) come from the arXiv comment fields. Proceedings pages were not checked: the web-search budget ran out and Semantic Scholar returned 429.
